name: Checkbox
purpose: Binary mark on a task: done state, or row multi-select membership. One widget covers the inspector header done toggle (md), subtask and multi-inspector squares (sm), and the round check on task rows in two intents. Intent sets the colour, so done never looks like selection. Merge record: from A Checkbox and RoundCheck (both kept as this widget; RoundCheck is dropped as a separate component, with its round shape as shape=round and its Option-held lamp as a caller-passed shape=square, size=sm, intent=done). The widget does not read the modifier; the caller reads Option or Alt and passes intent (critique). The round select's white centre dot is kept as recorded (B's standard glyph is not adopted). From B Checkbox: sizes, shape and intent axes adopted. Default size is sm (critique: A's md default was backwards). Sources: A Checkbox, A RoundCheck, B Checkbox. Catalogue sizes are px; they convert to rem at 1rem = 14px in the token layer.
base: Radix Checkbox. The select intent is an open role question (see role and open).

values.when: 16x16 box, radius 4.375px, check icon 12px. Used for subtasks, the multi-inspector selected list, the task rows (done and select) and the Option-held done lamp. Covers 'checkbox, small square', 'task done checkbox, round, labelled Select' and 'task row select toggle, round'.

18x18 box, check icon 14px, weight 700. Used only for the whole-task header control in the task inspector. Covers 'checkbox, medium (inspector header)'. Radius not recorded; md shape is square by assumption (open).
Radius rounded-field (4.375px). Inspector header, subtasks, multi-inspector list, and the Option-held done lamp.
Radius 50%. Task rows: the done check and the row-select toggle.
Checked fill is the done-lamp token, not accent blue. Used wherever a task is marked done. Round done checks and the square inspector and subtask checks use this intent.
Checked fill is the selection accent (oklch(0.62 0.13 255)) with an inner white dot. Used for row multi-select membership on task rows (plain click; Option switches the caller to done).

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: The caller routes it: intent=done calls actToggleDone on the task or subtask; intent=select calls the membership toggle. Replaces A's onToggle(next, intent), which made the widget report the modifier.

props.name: intent
props.description: Variant prop (cva). The caller sets intent=done, shape=square and size=sm while Option (Alt on Windows and web) is held on a round select check. The widget does not read keys.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required accessible name: 'Mark done' or 'Mark not done' for done; 'Select' or 'Deselect' for select (the catalogue's example names). The reference's round done check is labelled 'Select', which is wrong for done and is corrected here.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not recorded in the catalogue; included for the standard Radix prop.

states: checked, select intent (accent fill with inner white dot)
unchecked, done intent (outline oklch(0.26 0.012 262) light / oklch(0.94 0.004 260) dark)
checked, done intent (done-lamp fill with check glyph; the token value is not recorded)
hover (round select: border shifts to content-3 on the row group)
option-held (transient; caller passes intent=done, shape=square, size=sm)
dark theme (same states on the dark tokens)
role: checkbox with aria-checked for both intents (B). Not aria-pressed for done: the reference's round done check reports aria-pressed=false with label 'Select', which exposes selection as if it were completion. Select intent: checkbox is the default here; A proposed a button with aria-pressed, and the catalogue records 'Check (button)' on rows 14 and 15 (unverified). Open.
keyboard: Tab focuses; Space toggles (Radix Checkbox). Option (macOS) or Alt (Windows and web) with Space, on a select-intent round check, acts as the done switch (proposed; the catalogue records only the pointer modifier). Plain double-click does not toggle done (catalogue, task-list). The keyboard done switch is proposed, not recorded.
replaces: task done checkbox, round, labelled Select
platform: Same visual on both. Done-switch modifier: Option on macOS; Alt on Windows and web (decision; the caller reads it). Web: Alt+Space may be taken by the browser or the OS window menu, and browser shortcuts take precedence, so web needs an alternative keyboard route. Row-body multi-select uses Control-click on Windows and Command-click on macOS (decision; handled by the list, not this widget).
open: 1) Default intent per screen: the catalogue records the done checkbox (rows 3, 10, 21, 23) with a plain click that toggles done and the accessible name 'Select'; the decision says plain click on the round handle selects and Option switches to done. The caller passes intent explicitly; confirm the default on each screen. 2) Done colour: the catalogue records accent-blue fill oklch(0.62 0.13 255) on checked done checks (rows 6, 7, 11), which conflicts with the decision (done uses its own done-lamp colour). Change to the done-lamp token. The done-lamp value is not recorded; the catalogue's done-row colour oklch(0.62 0.013 264) is unverified. 3) Two accent blues: oklch(0.62 0.13 255) (checkboxes, round handle) and oklch(0.6 0.2 255) (segmented control, settings tab). Choose one token and name it selection (shadcn's accent is a neutral hover fill). 4) Select intent role: checkbox (aria-checked) here versus a toggle button (aria-pressed, A's proposal). The catalogue records 'Check (button)' on rows 14 and 15, and that component is '?' and unverified. 5) Multi-inspector square checkbox intent conflict: A records onCheckedChange calling actToggleDone (done); B records intent=select. Confirm which. 6) Round select's picked inner white dot (catalogue) is kept; B's standard check glyph is not adopted; confirm. 7) Whether the round done check (row 3) and the row-select toggle (row 5) are one control switched by Option, or two. The widget supports both. 8) Kind conflict: the catalogue records kind round-check for rows 21 and 23 but kind checkbox for rows 3 and 10. Reconcile before choosing a kind. 9) The round done check in row 3 looks empty in the screenshot although recorded as checked; unresolved. 10) Draft-inspector row count: the recorded row says 8 tasks but its state list has 9 (the catalogue flags this). Do not rely on the row-10 count until rows-choice.json is reconciled. 11) md radius not recorded; md shape=square is assumed. 12) Option-held square lamp: radius 4.375px is the same as the small square; it could reuse size sm (to confirm). 13) Unchecked outline: the open round rows use an oklch(0.26) glyph colour, the select ring is grey. Folded to one unchecked border token; confirm. 14) Border colour on multi-inspector sm not recorded. 15) No component is recorded on filter-panel and trash for 'task done checkbox, round'; those rows are unmapped. 16) Multi-inspector rows 14 and 15 have component '?'. 17) Disabled and focus-visible not recorded. 18) Row mapping is taken from the catalogue as written.
